author: Claude (AI assistant) - reference A, AI-written; must be paired with an independent reference B by a team member
note: Written from docs/Architecture.md ("Key Concepts": SPA with an internal router, providers, smart components, composition, headless ra-core hooks as MVC controllers with ra-ui-materialui as the view, contexts) and the source at the commit above, without any ArchTime output for this repository (it has not been mined). Each functional component joins the ra-core controller and the ra-ui-materialui view of one concern, as the document pairs them (useListController / <List>). Left unassigned: examples/, cypress/, codemods, Storybook helpers and the test-ui kit.
sources: docs/Architecture.md: Single-Page Application, Providers, Smart Components, Composition, Hooks (ra-core headless, Controller hooks), Context: Pull, Don't Push
docs/DataProviders.md, docs/Authentication.md, docs/Translation.md, docs/Store.md (one provider per concern)

components.name: Admin core and resources
components.responsibility: The <Admin> / CoreAdmin application root, resource definitions and their contexts, custom routes, the react-admin meta-package and shared core utilities and types.
evidence: Architecture.md: <Resource> links CRUD pages; the <Admin> component creates the contexts

components.name: Routing
components.responsibility: The internal router abstraction (react-router by default) and the TanStack Router adapter.
evidence: Architecture.md "Single-Page Application": an internal router displays the screen for each URL

components.name: Data provider layer
components.responsibility: The dataProvider interface, data hooks (useGetList, useUpdate...), caching and mutation modes, and the bundled data providers (REST, JSON server, GraphQL, local storage, FakeRest).
evidence: Architecture.md "Providers": components never call fetch; they go through the dataProvider

components.name: Authentication and authorization
components.responsibility: The authProvider, login / logout / permission hooks and access control, and the login page and user menu views.

components.name: Internationalization
components.responsibility: The i18nProvider, translate hooks, the Polyglot and i18next adapters and the English and French messages.
evidence: Architecture.md: <Admin> creates an I18NProviderContext read by useTranslate

components.name: Store and preferences
components.responsibility: The store (user preferences persisted across sessions) and configurable components that edit them.

components.name: List views and data tables
components.responsibility: List controllers (filters, sort, pagination, selection), the data table, export, and the List, Datagrid / DataTable, filter and pagination views.

components.name: Record pages (show, edit, create)
components.responsibility: Controllers and views for showing, editing and creating one record, the record and save contexts, previous / next navigation.
evidence: Architecture.md: <Show> fetches a record and exposes it via a RecordContext

components.name: Forms and inputs
components.responsibility: Form state and validation, input controllers, the input components and the rich-text input.
evidence: Architecture.md "Smart Components": sub-forms, inputs; composition of form parts

components.name: Fields and references
components.responsibility: Field controllers, reference fetching between resources, and the field components that display record values.
evidence: Architecture.md: related entities are linked through references

components.name: Actions and buttons
components.responsibility: Action controllers (delete, bulk actions, export...) and the button components.

components.name: Layout and theme
components.responsibility: The application layout, menu, app bar, notifications display, theming, links, keyboard shortcuts and the offline indicator.

components.name: Notifications
components.responsibility: The notification queue and hooks used to show messages to the user.

components.name: Guessers (inference)
components.responsibility: Infers list, show and edit views from the data returned by the API.

components.name: No-code builder
components.responsibility: ra-no-code: builds an admin from imported data without writing code.

components.name: Project scaffolding
components.responsibility: create-react-admin: creates a new application from a template.
